description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CustomPrint"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/custom-3d-print">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CustomPrint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SketchesToArtist" name="Sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProjectToCustomer" name="Project (STL)" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Project"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ChangesToArtist" name="Change request" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer: 3D model creation and printing" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Craving" name="Craving a custom 3D model">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Instruct artist: send sketches">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RevisionMerge" name="Revision merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Project" name="Receive project from artist">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with result?" default="Flow_06">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell artist what to change">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockSplit" name="Color in stock at home?" default="Flow_10">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAmount" name="Check how much color is left">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountSplit" name="Less than 100 g left?" default="Flow_13">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Put color on shopping list">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountJoin" name="Amount checked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderColor" name="Order the color">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ColorArrived" name="Ordered color arrived">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PlasticMerge" name="Plastic available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepSplit" name="Start preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TurnOnPrinter" name="Turn on printer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_HeatSplit" name="Heating and status">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatBedExtruder" name="Heat up bed and extruder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_24</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_PrinterStatus" name="Receive printer status updates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate G-code from STL file">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_26</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepJoin" name="Printer ready and G-code generated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_24</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_26</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_27</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print the model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_27</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_28</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Printed" name="Model printed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_28</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Craving" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Gateway_RevisionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_RevisionMerge" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Project"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Project" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${satisfied == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Gateway_RevisionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_StockSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${inStock == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_OrderColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_AmountSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${remainingGrams < 100}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AmountJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_AmountJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PlasticMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_OrderColor" targetRef="Event_ColorArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Event_ColorArrived" targetRef="Gateway_PlasticMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_PlasticMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_HeatSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_HeatSplit" targetRef="Task_HeatBedExtruder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_HeatSplit" targetRef="ReceiveTask_PrinterStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_HeatBedExtruder" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_PrinterStatus" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="EndEvent_Printed"/>

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
